CALCULATE.description: Evaluates an expression in a modified filter context.

CALCULATETABLE.description: Returns a table of values as a result of applying a filter.

SUM.description: Adds all the numbers in a column.

SUMX.description: Returns the sum of an expression evaluated for each row in a table.

COUNT.description: Counts the number of numeric values in a column.

COUNTA.description: Counts the number of non-blank values in a column.

COUNTX.description: Counts the number of rows that contain a non-blank result from an expression.

COUNTROWS.description: Counts the number of rows in a table.

COUNTBLANK.description: Counts the number of blank cells in a column.

DISTINCTCOUNT.description: Counts the number of distinct values in a column.

AVERAGE.description: Returns the average (arithmetic mean) of all numbers in a column.

AVERAGEX.description: Calculates the average of an expression evaluated for each row in a table.

MIN.description: Returns the smallest numeric value in a column.

MINX.description: Returns the smallest value from an expression evaluated over a table.

MAX.description: Returns the largest numeric value in a column.

MAXX.description: Returns the largest value from an expression evaluated over a table.

FILTER.description: Returns a table that represents a subset of another table or expression.

ALL.description: Returns all the rows in a table, ignoring any filters.

ALLEXCEPT.description: Removes all context filters except filters applied to specified columns.

ALLSELECTED.description: Returns all the rows in a table considering only the filters applied outside the current context.

VALUES.description: Returns a one-column table containing the distinct values from a column.

DISTINCT.description: Returns a one-column table of distinct values from a column or expression.

RELATED.description: Returns a related value from another table using the relationship.

RELATEDTABLE.description: Returns all rows from a related table that are related to the current row.

IF.description: Checks a condition and returns one value when true, another when false.

IFERROR.description: Returns a value you specify if an expression evaluates to an error.

SWITCH.description: Evaluates an expression against a list of values and returns the result of the first matching expression.

DIVIDE.description: Performs division and returns an alternate result or BLANK on division by zero.

RANKX.description: Returns the ranking of a number in a list of numbers for each row in a table.

TOPN.description: Returns the top N rows of a specified table.

EARLIER.description: Returns the current value of a column in an outer evaluation pass of the given column.

HASONEVALUE.description: Returns TRUE when the context for a column has been filtered down to one distinct value only.

SELECTEDVALUE.description: Returns the value when the context for a column has been filtered to one distinct value only.

FIRSTNONBLANK.description: Returns the first value in a column for which the expression is not blank.

LASTNONBLANK.description: Returns the last value in a column for which the expression is not blank.

DATEADD.description: Returns a table with a column of dates shifted in time by a specified number of intervals.

DATESYTD.description: Returns a set of dates in the year up to the last date in the filter context.

DATESMTD.description: Returns a set of dates in the month up to the last date in the filter context.

DATESQTD.description: Returns a set of dates in the quarter up to the last date in the filter context.

SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR.description: Returns a set of dates from the previous year corresponding to the current context.

TOTALYTD.description: Evaluates the year-to-date value of an expression.

TOTALMTD.description: Evaluates the month-to-date value of an expression.

PREVIOUSYEAR.description: Returns all dates from the previous year in the current filter context.

PREVIOUSMONTH.description: Returns all dates from the previous month in the current filter context.

PARALLELPERIOD.description: Returns a table with a parallel period shifted by a number of intervals.

USERELATIONSHIP.description: Specifies the relationship to use in a specific calculation.

VAR.description: Stores the result of an expression as a named variable (used with RETURN).

RETURN.description: Returns the result of a VAR expression.

CONCATENATE.description: Joins two text strings into one.

CONCATENATEX.description: Concatenates the result of an expression evaluated for each row in a table.

FORMAT.description: Converts a value to text in the specified number format.

ISBLANK.description: Checks whether a value is blank, and returns TRUE or FALSE.

LOOKUPVALUE.description: Returns the value from a column for a row that meets specified criteria.

GENERATE.description: Returns a table with the Cartesian product of each row in table1 and the table from evaluating table2 expression.

CROSSJOIN.description: Returns a table that is the cross join of the specified tables.

TREATAS.description: Applies the values of a table as filters on columns from an unrelated table.

CONTAINS.description: Returns TRUE if a table contains a row with the specified column values.

KEEPFILTERS.description: Modifies how filters are applied while evaluating a CALCULATE function.
